source_of_truth: Synthetic dogfood contract for Plan F2 / F004. Mirrors a representative parity goal (browse + checkout + error_recovery journeys). Not a real product surface — intentionally constructed so F001 surfaces one missing_evidence + one journey_gap finding.

user_journeys.name: browse_journey
user_journeys.description: Visitor lands on the catalog, scrolls a product list, and renders item cards without errors. Used by the dogfood as a journey with full evidence coverage (web + log artifacts captured under post_impl).
acceptance_signals: ≥1 product card displays a price string

user_journeys.name: checkout_journey
user_journeys.description: Authenticated user completes a checkout from cart through confirmation, with the backend persisting the order and the iOS surface presenting the success screen.
acceptance_signals: checkout success screen renders within 3 seconds of submit
backend log records order id + total

user_journeys.name: error_recovery
user_journeys.description: User encounters a network error mid-checkout and the surface recovers (retries automatically OR surfaces a retry affordance) without crashing or losing cart state. Intentionally orphan in this dogfood — zero captured artifacts under any source surface — so F001 emits a journey_gap finding.
acceptance_signals: retry banner appears within 1 second of network failure

completion_test: Both browse_journey and checkout_journey complete end-to-end without operator intervention, AND error_recovery presents a retry affordance instead of crashing on simulated network failure. The first four required_evidence matchers map to artifacts captured by the runtime adapters; the fifth (crash-NoneObserved) is intentionally NOT captured so the v1 evidence-coverage heuristic emits a missing_evidence finding.
